# Children's Wisconsin

> A top-ranked pediatric health system providing comprehensive care from primary care and urgent services to emergency trauma care, research, and family support resources across southeast Wisconsin.

Children's Wisconsin is a leading pediatric healthcare provider serving Wisconsin with multiple clinic locations, a Level I emergency and trauma center, and integrated mental health services. The system combines clinical excellence with family-centered resources, parenting education, and translational research through the Children's Research Institute.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric health system
- Primary care clinics
- Urgent care services
- Emergency and trauma center
- Mental health and behavioral wellness
- Video visits and telemedicine
- MyChart patient portal
- Pediatric research
- Family resources and parenting guides
- Insurance and billing
- Medical records access
- Walk-in clinics
- Specialty care
- Child safety and injury prevention
- Healthy eating and nutrition

## Find Care & Services

- [Find a Pediatrician Near You | 20+ Clinics | Children's Wisconsin](https://childrenswi.org/Find-Care/Primary-care): Primary care clinic locations and pediatrician finder across southeast Wisconsin.
- [Urgent care | Children's Wisconsin](https://childrenswi.org/Find-Care/Urgent-Care): Walk-in urgent care clinics for children and adolescents with extended hours.
- [Online Urgent Care | Children's Wisconsin](https://childrenswi.org/Find-Care/Urgent-Care-Video-Visit): Video urgent care visits for pediatric patients available from home via MyChart.
- [Walk-in mental health care | Children's Wisconsin](https://childrenswi.org/Find-Care/Mental-Behavioral-Health/Walk-in-Mental-Health-Care): Same-day mental health walk-in clinics for children and teens experiencing crises.
- [Emergency Department and Trauma Center (EDTC) | Children's Wisconsin](https://childrenswi.org/Locations/Emergency-Department-and-Trauma-Center): Level I pediatric emergency and trauma center with 24/7 full-service support.

## Family Resources & Support

- [Patients and Visitors | Children's Wisconsin](https://childrenswi.org/Family-Resources/Patients-Visitors): Hospital visit guidelines, visitor rules, and family support services and resources.
- [Insurance, Billing and Payments | Children's Wisconsin](https://childrenswi.org/Family-Resources/Insurance-Billing-Payments): Insurance coverage, billing options, and financial assistance information.
- [Medical Records | Children's Wisconsin](https://childrenswi.org/Family-Resources/Patients-Visitors/Medical-Records): Medical records request process and MyChart online access for patient information.
- [Grief Support | Children's Wisconsin](https://childrenswi.org/Family-Resources/Parenting-Resources/Grief-Support): Grief counseling and support groups for families experiencing child loss.

## Parenting Resources & Education

- [Family Resource Centers | Children's Wisconsin](https://childrenswi.org/Family-Resources/Parenting-Resources/Family-Resource-Centers): Free parenting classes, family resource centers, and community support programs.
- [Health Resources | Children's Wisconsin](https://childrenswi.org/Family-Resources/Parenting-Resources/Health-Resources): Expert health guides for managing diabetes, feeding tubes, allergies, and conditions.
- [Healthy Eating and Active Living | Children's Wisconsin](https://childrenswi.org/Family-Resources/Parenting-Resources/Healthy-Eating-Active-Living): Nutrition and wellness programs including NEW Kids weight management initiative.
- [Safety Center | Children's Wisconsin](https://childrenswi.org/Family-Resources/Parenting-Resources/Safety-Center): Child safety resources on car seats, teen driving, and injury prevention.

## Research & Professional Resources

- [Pediatric Research | Children's Wisconsin](https://childrenswi.org/Research): Children's Research Institute programs advancing pediatric health through translational research.
- [Medical Professionals | Children's Wisconsin](https://childrenswi.org/Medical-Professionals): Resources and support for physicians and healthcare providers at Children's Wisconsin.

## Organization & Careers

- [Top Ranked Pediatric Health System | Children's Wisconsin](https://childrenswi.org): Children's Wisconsin homepage showcasing pediatric health services and patient stories.
- [Careers | Children's Wisconsin](https://childrenswi.org/Careers): Job opportunities and career information at Children's Wisconsin healthcare system.
